provenance.question: does selecting inside the near-optimal set on VALIDATION pairs beat the shipped max-margin theta on held-out pairs, and does a selection-free aggregate beat both?
provenance.candidates: the reference plus every theta admitted by the random walk with exact regret within slack_rel of the reference's (same sampler as D1 / face.py)
provenance.selection: mean miss@5% over 6 validation pairs drawn from the TRAINING subjects (0-4), which are subject-disjoint from the test subjects (5-9); the test pairs take no part in it
provenance.arms: reference (shipped max-margin), selected (validation-best), median (coordinate-wise median of the admitted set, renormalised -- selection-free), uniform
provenance.metric: geodesic miss@5% on the 8 held-out pairs, paired bootstrap over pairs
provenance.memory: one n x n cost and one n x n geodesic matrix at a time; ~128 MB each at n=4000
